CEO Patrick Miles said in an SEC filing that he bought about $1M worth of company stock.
Miles purchased 115,000 shares of common stock at a weighted average price of $8.81. After the transaction, Miles directly owned 5.8M shares of the company.
ATEC shares gained 7.1% in premarket trading on Friday. Shares of the medical-device company have fallen about 58% so far this year as of the previous close.

title: Alphatec CEO buys $1M in company stock
